card.name: Scattered words in religious and web prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on varied connecting words and nouns in biblical quotations, patent boilerplate and web text.

modes.label: Scripture clause breaks
modes.description: Punctuation or 'as' right after a name in a quoted Bible passage.
